desc.0: When Nekomata's <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</ct> or <ct color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</ct> hits an enemy, her DMG increases by <ct color=#2BAD00>30%</ct> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
desc.1: Nekomata gains 40 <tooltip ns=tooltips_gen baseKey18=1000024>Purr Energy</tooltip></Term> upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
desc.2: While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
desc.3: When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</ct>, press <IconEvade /> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press <IconNormal /> to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
desc.4: When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold <IconNormal /> to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.

desc.6: While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of <ct color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</ct> equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
desc.7: Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

desc.0: When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
desc.1: After Nekomata uses <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</ct>, or after any squad member inflicts <ct color=#F0D12B>Assault</ct> on an enemy, Nekomata's <ct color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</ct> and <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</ct> deal 35% more DMG on hit. This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1.name: Bird Hunter
1.desc: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's <ct color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</ct>. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
1.flavor: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

2.name: Cat & Mouse
2.desc: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.

flavor.0: Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
flavor.1: If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

3.name: Curious Left Tail
3.desc: <ct color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Assist</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</ct>, and <ct color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</ct> Lv. +2

flavor.0: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
flavor.1: Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

4.name: Sharpen Claws
4.desc: When Nekomata uses her <ct color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</ct>, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.

flavor.0: "Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
flavor.1: Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

5.name: Lucky Right Tail
5.desc: <ct color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Assist</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</ct>, and <ct color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</ct> Lv. +2
5.flavor: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

6.name: Predator Lineage
6.desc: When Nekomata launches a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</ct> or uses her <ct color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</ct>, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.

flavor.0: "When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
flavor.3: —Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens
